interpretation: The split controller tolerates the controller prefetch TICK in Evolution 1, the game whose controller timing failed before.
Prefetch removes the residual gameplay lag the owner saw in Evolution 1.

Each TICK performs up to two synchronous 512-byte PIO blocks inside the masked Maple completion hook. During continuous FMV streaming that work recurs every controller frame while adding little data relative to the stream; the SA2 regression is consistent with that cost, but its cause is not measured.
